item.title: Connectivity Options
item.description:
Choose a Backhaul

Gateway XS uses either Haltian-managed cellular connectivity or wired LAN for its cloud connection. Choose the backhaul before installation.

Cellular: Standard Option

Haltian preconfigures the SIM and cellular connection for the standard deployment. Install the antennas and connect power; the gateway connects automatically. No customer network configuration is required.

Confirm LTE coverage at the installation site before mounting. See Installation and Configuration.

Wired LAN: Customer-Specific Alternative

Use LAN when cellular is unavailable or the deployment’s IT or security requirements call for a wired connection. LAN is available for customer-specific deployments; contact Haltian support before installation to confirm service scope and network requirements.

item.title: Specifications
item.description:
Hardware

Component Specification
Main CPU NXP i.MX9352
Architecture ARM Cortex-A55, dual-core
Clock speed 1.7 GHz
RAM 1 GB
Storage 16 GB internal
Operating system Embedded Linux (Debian-based)

Connectivity

Feature Specification
Ethernet interface RJ45
Ethernet availability Supported for customer-specific LAN deployments
Cellular technology LTE Cat.1bis
Cellular data rate Up to 10 Mbps downlink, 5 Mbps uplink
SIM Pre-installed and configured by Haltian
Antenna connectors External, SMA connector
Customer setup No customer network configuration required for standard cellular deployment; LAN deployments require customer network setup
MQTT Haltian IoT platform (default). Optional, separately priced secondary endpoint sends data in parallel to the customer’s own MQTT server.
Status LEDs 2 (green: MQTT connection, amber: cellular network)
Short-range radio Nordic nRF52840, 2.4 GHz ISM band
Protocol support Wirepas Mesh, installed by default; Gateway XS operates as a mesh sink

Cellular bands

Gateway XS supports the following LTE frequency bands through its LTE Cat.1bis modem. Band support does not guarantee service with every operator or at every deployment location; confirm coverage and operator compatibility before deployment.

item.title: Installation
item.description:
Before You Begin

Choose a Backhaul

Gateway XS uses either cellular or wired LAN for its cloud connection. Choose the backhaul and confirm its requirements before installation and mounting.

  • Cellular (standard deployment): Haltian pre-configures the SIM and connectivity. Confirm LTE coverage at the installation site.
  • Wired LAN (customer-specific deployment): Confirm availability and approved network settings with Haltian before installation. Haltian delivers a unique console password for each gateway to the customer during the delivery phase; have the password for this gateway before setup. Configure Ethernet after power-up using the LAN Setup Console guide.

Package Contents

Verify you have received all components:

item.title: LAN Setup
item.description:
Before You Begin

The LAN Setup Console is a text-based tool built into Gateway XS. Connect to it over the serial interface using a computer and terminal program. SSH, Telnet, and a web browser cannot access the console.

You need:

  • A powered-on Gateway XS
  • A data-capable micro-USB cable connected to the front DBG port. Do not use the USB-C port.
  • A USB-A to USB-C adapter or cable if needed
  • The CP210x USB-to-UART driver. Download the appropriate driver from Silicon Labs. On Windows, use the CP210x Universal Windows Driver. macOS may already include the driver.
  • A serial terminal: Terminal on macOS, or PuTTY (or similar) on Windows
  • The unique console password for this gateway, available from Haltian Studio or on the password slip delivered with the Gateway XS. Have the password before starting setup.

The console uses a serial connection over the micro-USB cable, not the network. SSH, Telnet, and web browsers cannot access it.

item.title: Configuration
item.description:
Overview

The Gateway XS is designed for minimal customer configuration. For the standard cellular deployment, Haltian pre-configures connectivity before delivery, and no customer network configuration is required. For wired Ethernet deployments, see Connectivity Options and LAN Setup.

Device Details

Use Haltian Field or Haltian Studio (Web) to maintain device details:

  • Device name: Assign a descriptive name that identifies the device’s location or purpose.
  • Images: Add or update a photo of the device or its installation.
  • Notes: Record installation details, configuration information, maintenance history, or other observations.
  • Keywords: Assign tags to categorize and find the device.

Editing the device name, images, notes, and keywords requires the Installer, Designer, or Manager role. See the Haltian IoT Applications overview, Studio Device Details, or Field Device Details for app-specific instructions.

item.title: Operation
item.description:
Normal Operation

Startup Sequence

Gateway boot process takes approximately 60–90 seconds:

  1. Power On (0-5 seconds)

    • Hardware initialization
    • Self-test procedures

  2. Network Initialization (5-30 seconds)

    • Network interfaces activate
    • Cellular registration

  3. Cloud Connection (30-60 seconds)

    • TLS connection establishment
    • Authentication and registration
    • NTP synchronization

  4. Wirepas Mesh Start (60-90 seconds)

    • 2.4 GHz radio initialization
    • Network scanning
    • Sink role activation

The gateway has two status LEDs: a green LED (left) for the MQTT connection and an amber LED (right) for the cellular network. In a healthy state the green LED is solid on and the amber LED is off. Use Haltian Studio to confirm the gateway is online.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description:
Quick Diagnostic Checklist

Before detailed troubleshooting, verify these basics:

  • Power supply connected and power supply indicator is on
  • Both antennas properly installed (finger-tight, no wobble)
  • Gateway appears in Haltian Studio (cloud connected)
  • Firmware version is current (check for updates)

Check the gateway’s status LEDs alongside Haltian Studio. For wired LAN diagnostics, use the LAN Setup Console.

Gateway Not Appearing Online

Symptom: Gateway does not show as Online in Haltian Studio within 5 minutes of power-on.

item.title: FAQ
item.description:
Connectivity options

Which backhaul options does Gateway XS support?

Gateway XS supports two cloud backhaul options:

  • Cellular: Haltian-managed LTE Cat.1bis connectivity
  • LAN: Wired Ethernet connectivity for customer-specific deployments

A deployment uses either cellular or LAN as its cloud backhaul according to the deployment requirements.

Can Gateway XS send data directly to my own MQTT server?

Yes, as an optional add-on. The gateway can send data to your server in parallel with the Haltian IoT platform using a secondary MQTT endpoint. The option is separately priced. Contact Haltian support to confirm the scope and network requirements.
